review: 702.194a-1: variant power_short assumed the engine silently casts without teamwork after an insufficient payment; rewrote its expected outcome as the payment being illegal.
702.194b-1: the token has flying (Forge script c_1_1_a_robot_hero_flying); added it to the expected outcome and dropped the forge_note asking to check the script.

scenarios.title: Teamwork taps creatures with total power N or more as an additional cost and enables the teamwork effect

setup.notes: Repulsor Blast has teamwork 2: it deals 5 damage to target creature, and 2 damage to that creature's controller if cast using teamwork.

decisions: A casts Repulsor Blast targeting Hill Giant, declaring teamwork by tapping Grizzly Bears (power 2) and paying {3}{R} with four Mountains.
Both players pass; Repulsor Blast resolves.

variants.label: teamwork_paid
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears becomes tapped as the additional cost. Repulsor Blast deals 5 damage to Hill Giant, which moves to B's graveyard, and 2 damage to B (18).

variants.label: no_teamwork
variants.delta: A does not declare teamwork, and no creature is tapped.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears stays untapped. Repulsor Blast deals 5 damage to Hill Giant, which moves to B's graveyard. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: power_short
variants.delta: A declares teamwork by tapping only Llanowar Elves (power 1) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Tapping creatures with total power 1 does not pay teamwork 2, so casting Repulsor Blast with that teamwork payment is not legal. Llanowar Elves stays untapped and Hill Giant takes no damage.

scenarios.title: A spell counts as cast using teamwork only if its controller declared the intention to pay the teamwork cost

setup.notes: Virtual Assistant is a 3/3 defender: 'whenever you cast a spell using teamwork, you may create a 1/1 colorless Robot Hero artifact creature token'. Beast Mode has teamwork 1: target creature gets +2/+2 and trample until end of turn, and a +1/+1 counter if cast using teamwork.

decisions: A casts Beast Mode targeting Virtual Assistant, declaring teamwork by tapping Grizzly Bears (power 2) and paying {1}{G} with two Forests.
Virtual Assistant's trigger goes on the stack; A chooses to create the token. Both players pass; the trigger resolves, then Beast Mode resolves.

variants.label: teamwork_declared
variants.expected: Virtual Assistant's trigger fires: A creates a 1/1 colorless Robot Hero artifact creature token with flying. Beast Mode gives Virtual Assistant +2/+2 and trample until end of turn and a +1/+1 counter (6/6 this turn).

variants.label: teamwork_not_declared
variants.delta: A does not declare teamwork when casting Beast Mode, and Grizzly Bears is not tapped.
variants.expected: Virtual Assistant's trigger does not fire and A creates no token. Beast Mode gives Virtual Assistant +2/+2 and trample until end of turn (5/5) and no counter.

scenarios.title: A target belonging to a teamwork-only part of a spell is chosen only if teamwork was used

setup.notes: Cruel Alliance has teamwork 2: exile target creature with mana value 3 or less; if cast using teamwork, instead exile target creature and gain 3 life. Hill Giant has mana value 4.

decisions: A checks whether Cruel Alliance can be cast targeting B's Hill Giant, declaring teamwork by tapping A's Hill Giant (power 3) and paying {2}{B} with three Swamps.

variants.label: teamwork_declared
variants.expected: Casting is legal: A's Hill Giant is tapped as the additional cost and A chooses target creature B's Hill Giant. On resolution B's Hill Giant is exiled and A gains 3 life (23).

variants.label: teamwork_not_declared
variants.expected: Casting is not legal: only the target 'creature with mana value 3 or less' is chosen, and no such creature is on the battlefield, so Cruel Alliance has no legal target and stays in A's hand.
